$comment: Unknown top-level keys are rejected. A new top-level values key must be declared here.

type.description: Connector type: oidc (any OpenID Connect provider), microsoft (Entra ID) or github.

id.description: Unique. Also names the Dex env vars.

secretRef.description: Secret in namespace auth with the client ID and client secret. Keelson never creates it. Put no secret values in values.

name.description: Secret in namespace auth. A name only.

clientIDKey.description: Key of the client ID in the Secret.

clientSecretKey.description: Key of the client secret in the Secret.

issuer.description: oidc: issuer URL of the identity provider. Required for oidc.

scopes.description: oidc: scopes to request. Default: openid, profile, email, groups. Remove groups for providers that reject it.

groupsClaim.description: oidc: claim that Dex reads groups from.

tenant.description: microsoft: tenant ID or verified domain. A domain is lowercase only. Multi-tenant values accept any account and drop groups.

allowedGroups.description: microsoft: only members may log in.

onlySecurityGroups.description: microsoft: return security groups only, no Microsoft 365 groups.

groupNameFormat.description: microsoft: return groups as names or as object IDs.

emailToLowercase.description: microsoft: Kubeflow compares user emails case-sensitively.

teams.description: Optional. Only members of one of these teams may log in.

orgs.description: github: required, so arbitrary GitHub users can't log in.

teamNameField.description: github: how teams appear in groups: team name, team slug or both. Keelson default: slug.

useLoginAsID.description: github: use the GitHub login as the user ID, not the numeric ID.

extraConfig.description: Unsupported. Merged last into the connector config. No secret-like keys. ASCII letters, digits and _ only.

global.description: Helm global values. Allowed so parent charts and --set global.* keep working.

upstream.description: The pinned upstream Kubeflow manifests that every Application uses.

manifestsRepo.description: Git URL of the upstream Kubeflow manifests. Every Application pulls from it.

manifestsRef.description: Pinned kubeflow/manifests release tag, e.g. 26.10.0. Branches and HEAD are not allowed.

platform.description: Cluster type. Selects platform-specific upstream overlays (source.platformPaths).

domain.description: Hostname for Kubeflow, no scheme, lowercase only (e.g. kubeflow.example.com). Empty keeps the upstream default: Gateway hosts "*", HTTP.

environment.description: production rejects auth.staticUsers, and needs at least one Dex connector and the secretRefs auth.oidcClient and auth.cookie.

auth.description: Login settings: the static user and the Dex connectors. See docs/configuration/authentication.md.

enabled.description: Upstream static user user@example.com. Kind and dev only.

oidcClient.description: The OIDC client that oauth2-proxy uses to log in with Dex. Both components must read the same client ID and secret.

secretRef.description: Secret with keys client-id and client-secret. Create it in both namespaces auth and oauth2-proxy. Keelson never creates it. Required with environment production.

name.description: Secret name. Not oauth2-proxy and not dex-oidc-client: those names are upstream's generated Secrets.

secretRef.description: Secret in namespace oauth2-proxy with key cookie-secret. Keelson never creates it. Required with environment production.

name.description: Secret name. Not oauth2-proxy and not dex-oidc-client: those names are upstream's generated Secrets.

connectors.description: Identity providers for Dex. Each connector needs domain. Static users off, or environment production, needs at least one.

issuer.description: none: HTTP. existing: Istio terminates TLS with secretRef. external: TLS ends in front of the cluster; cookies are secure. selfsigned: Keelson issues a self-signed certificate (Secret keelson-tls). letsencrypt: lands in part 2 of #23.

secretRef.description: TLS Secret for issuer existing. A name only.

name.description: kubernetes.io/tls Secret in istio-system (issuer=existing). A name only, never key material.

workspaces.description: Settings for the workspaces and workspace-kinds modules.

kinds.description: Upstream sample WorkspaceKinds to install (workspace-kinds module): any of codeserver, jupyterlab, rstudio. [] installs none.

argocd.description: ArgoCD settings: where Keelson creates its Applications, and which AppProject they use.

namespace.description: Namespace of ArgoCD. Keelson creates the AppProject and the Applications in it.

project.description: Name of the AppProject that Keelson creates. Every Application uses it.

destinationServer.description: Cluster API URL for Application destinations. The default is the in-cluster server.

extraSourceRepos.description: Extra repos allowed in the AppProject, after upstream.manifestsRepo.

profiles.description: Kubeflow profiles as code. Names must be unique (checked at render time).

owner.description: Owner email: the kubeflow-userid header value.

contributors.description: Emails with edit access (ClusterRole kubeflow-edit), as the dashboard's Manage contributors adds them.

groups.description: Not supported yet. Rejected at render time; see issue #28.

keelson.description: Settings for Keelson's own chart, used by component Applications (ADR 0004).

selfSource.description: Where component Applications pull this chart from (ADR 0004).

repoURL.description: OCI registry path, no scheme (e.g. ghcr.io/org/charts).

targetRevision.description: Empty: this chart's version. Otherwise an exact SemVer version.

component.description: Internal. Only the engine sets it, in component Applications (ADR 0004).

profileNamespaceLabels.description: Extra labels on every profile namespace. Pod Security and upstream label keys are rejected. An empty value removes the label. See docs/configuration/profile-namespaces.md.

enabled.description: Turn the module on or off. The default comes from the module file (defaultEnabled).

modules.description: Per-module switches keyed by module name. Unknown names fail at render time.

advanced.description: Unsupported escape hatches. They can break on upgrade.

modules.description: Per-module overrides keyed by module name. Unknown names fail at render time.

appSpecOverride.description: Unsupported. Deep-merged over the generated Application spec.
